items.condition: A submitted candidate cannot be traced to the named 68-atom XYZ input, or atom ordering/charge/multiplicity is changed without documentation.
A candidate is reported as a transition state without frequency evidence, or the imaginary mode is unrelated to migratory insertion.

A barrier uses an undeclared or wrong local reference (INT2A-quartet is required for TS3A/B and INT2B-quartet for TS3C/D), substitutes a separated-reference profile height without a calculated transformation, or mixes incompatible thermal/solvation conventions. The explicitly designated two local references are not themselves a reference-mixing failure.
The report omits one or more attempted labels and provides neither a result nor a scientifically specific failure explanation.
